description: Get the structured record for one Gazette notice by its ID (from any gazette search tool, or a thegazette.co.uk/notice/<id> URL). Returns the notice type, publication date, gazette edition and issue, companies named (with Companies House numbers), people, addresses with coordinates, related legislation, and key dates. Example: gazette_get_notice({ notice_id: "4123456" })

notice_id.description: Notice ID — numeric (e.g. "4123456") or legacy alphanumeric (e.g. "L-60768-1986497")

name: gazette_get_notice
